+import json
+import os
+import sys
+import time
+import uuid
+
+import requests
+
+
+NEW_RELIC_INGEST_URL = "https://log-api.newrelic.com/log/v1"
+
+
+def build_events(correlation_id: str):
+    now = int(time.time() * 1000)
+    return [
+        {
+            "timestamp": now,
+            "message": "request started",
+            "level": "INFO",
+            "service.name": os.getenv("SERVICE_NAME", "example-app"),
+            "request.id": correlation_id,
+            "correlation.id": correlation_id,
+        },
+        {
+            "timestamp": now + 10,
+            "message": "request completed",
+            "level": "INFO",
+            "service.name": os.getenv("SERVICE_NAME", "example-app"),
+            "request.id": correlation_id,
+            "correlation.id": correlation_id,
+        },
+    ]
+
+
+def send_logs(events):
+    license_key = os.getenv("NEW_RELIC_LICENSE_KEY")
+    if not license_key:
+        raise RuntimeError("NEW_RELIC_LICENSE_KEY is required")
+    headers = {
+        "Api-Key": license_key,
+        "Content-Type": "application/json",
+    }
+    response = requests.post(NEW_RELIC_INGEST_URL, headers=headers, data=json.dumps(events), timeout=30)
+    response.raise_for_status()
+
+
+def main():
+    correlation_id = os.getenv("CORRELATION_ID", str(uuid.uuid4()))
+    events = build_events(correlation_id)
+    send_logs(events)
+    sys.stdout.write(correlation_id + "\n")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch

data.text:
"Create write_structured_log.py in the current working directory.
Task: writes a structured JSON log event to a managed logging service.
Use one concrete external provider and make that provider identifiable in code.
"

input.patchText:
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: write_structured_log.py
+import json
+import os
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+
+import requests
+
+
+def write_structured_log(message: str, level: str = "info", **fields):
+    api_key = os.environ["LOGTAIL_SOURCE_TOKEN"]
+    source_token = os.environ.get("LOGTAIL_SOURCE_TOKEN")
+    if not source_token:
+        raise RuntimeError("LOGTAIL_SOURCE_TOKEN is required")
+
+    payload = {
+        "dt": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
+        "level": level,
+        "message": message,
+        **fields,
+    }
+
+    response = requests.post(
+        "https://in.logs.betterstack.com",
+        headers={
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+            "Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}",
+        },
+        data=json.dumps(payload),
+        timeout=10,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    return response.json() if response.content else None
+
*** End Patch
